options.content:
## Kiro Session → Delivery Trace
Traces AI sessions to delivery through commit-message trailers: **session → commit → merged PR → issue**.

- Data source: the `extractKiroSessionCommits` subtask (enabled by default in the kiro plugin) parses `Kiro-Session-Id` / `Devdelta-Session-Id` trailers out of commit messages already collected into the lake.
- **This is an AS-IS association**: no author verification and no trust gating. DevDelta's three-edge attribution (author match + trailer + SHA in merged PR) is the audited version; treat these numbers as descriptive lineage, not verified attribution.
- PR→issue edges come from `pull_request_issues`, which depends on teams referencing issue keys in PR titles/descriptions/branch names — missing links usually mean a missing convention, not missing AI work.
- **Per person** row: one series per *person* in every band, on one shared time axis, so a week can be read top-to-bottom: credits spent → AI-linked commits → PRs merged → issues resolved. People come from DevLake's **curated identity mapping** (`users` / `user_accounts`, i.e. the org plugin's users.csv and user_accounts.csv) — never from a heuristic. Pick people in the **Person** selector; colours are assigned by name, so a person keeps one colour across bands. Accounts nobody has mapped do not appear there.
- The collapsed **By raw identity** row keeps the four unmapped namespaces — Kiro users, PR authors (forge logins), issue assignees, git author emails — side by side and deliberately NOT merged: the only merge on this dashboard is the curated mapping above.

panels.title: Session-linked commits
panels.description: Distinct commits carrying a session trailer, authored in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Sessions reaching a commit
panels.description: Distinct session ids named by any commit in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Merged PRs touched
panels.description: Merged PRs containing at least one session-linked commit

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Issues reached
panels.description: Issues linked (via pull_request_issues) to a session-touched merged PR

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) AS value FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project))

panels.title: Per person: credits → AI-linked commits → merged PRs → resolved issues (curated identity mapping; pick people above)
Credits per week
panels.description: Kiro credits (official usage report) per person per week. Identity: user_email → user_accounts → users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(r.date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(r.date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, u.name AS metric, SUM(r.credits_used) AS credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = r.user_email JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) AND u.name IN ($person) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Session-linked commits per week
panels.description: Commits carrying a session trailer, per person per week. Identity: commit author_id → user_accounts → users. The bridge between spend (above) and delivery (below).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, u.name AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS session_linked_commits FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = c.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND u.name IN ($person) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Merged PRs per week
panels.description: Merged pull requests per person per week. Identity: PR author_id → user_accounts → users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, u.name AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS merged_prs FROM pull_requests pr JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = pr.author_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND u.name IN ($person) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Issues resolved per week
panels.description: Issues with a resolution date per person per week (assignee). Identity: assignee_id → user_accounts → users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, u.name AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS resolved_issues FROM issues i JOIN user_accounts ua ON ua.account_id = i.assignee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) AND u.name IN ($person) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Credits per week (total)
panels.description: From _tool_kiro_user_report (official billing). Not project-filtered: credits have no repo dimension.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(r.date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(r.date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, SUM(r.credits_used) AS credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues resolved per week (total)
panels.description: All resolved issues by resolution_date. Not project-filtered by repo; issue boards may span projects.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS resolved_issues FROM issues i WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By raw identity (unmapped namespaces: Kiro users · PR authors · issue assignees · git emails)
Credits per week by person (Kiro users)
panels.description: One series per Kiro user (display name, falling back to user id). Namespace: Kiro identity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(r.date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(r.date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, COALESCE(MAX(r.display_name), r.user_id) AS metric, SUM(r.credits_used) AS credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.date) GROUP BY 1, r.user_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Merged PRs per week by PR author
panels.description: One series per PR author (code-host login, as collected by the forge plugin). Namespace: code-host identity. Same week buckets as the credits and issue panels, so a person can be read across all three.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, CASE WHEN pr.author_name = '' OR pr.author_name IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE pr.author_name END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS merged_prs FROM pull_requests pr WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Issues resolved per week by assignee
panels.description: One series per issue assignee. Namespace: issue tracker identity — not merged with Kiro users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(i.resolution_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS resolved_issues FROM issues i WHERE i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session-linked commits per week by author
panels.description: One series per git author email; counts commits carrying a session trailer. Namespace: git identity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, CASE WHEN c.author_email = '' OR c.author_email IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.author_email END AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS session_linked_commits FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Commits: all vs session-linked (weekly)
panels.description: Gap between the bars = commits without a trailer (human-only work, or hooks not installed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(c.authored_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS all_commits, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS session_linked FROM commits c JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha LEFT JOIN _tool_kiro_session_commits sc ON sc.commit_sha = c.sha WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Merged PRs: all vs session-linked (weekly)
panels.description: A PR counts as session-linked when any of its commits carries a trailer

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE) - (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM CAST(pr.merged_date AS DATE)) - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS merged_prs, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN pr.id END) AS session_linked_prs FROM pull_requests pr JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN _tool_kiro_session_commits sc ON sc.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session → Commit → PR → Issue (latest 200)
panels.description: Empty PR/Issue cells mean that hop has no edge yet: PR not merged/collected, or no issue key referenced

targets.rawSql: SELECT sc.session_id AS "Session", sc.trailer_key AS "Agent", SUBSTRING(sc.commit_sha, 1, 8) AS "Commit", c.authored_date AS "Authored", pr.pull_request_key AS "PR #", pr.title AS "PR Title", pr.merged_date AS "Merged", pri.issue_key AS "Issue", i.title AS "Issue Title", i.type AS "Issue Type", i.assignee_name AS "Assignee" FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id LEFT JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) ORDER BY c.authored_date DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Issues by AI involvement (dose, as-is)
panels.description: Sessions/commits/PRs per issue. Dose comparison is only meaningful within similar task types.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pri.issue_key AS "Issue", MAX(i.title) AS "Title", MAX(i.type) AS "Type", MAX(CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END) AS "Assignee", COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS "Sessions", COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS "Commits", COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS "PRs" FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY pri.issue_key ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Assignees by AI-linked delivery
panels.description: Per-assignee rollup of AI-linked issues/PRs/sessions. Descriptive only — NOT a ranking; task mix differs per person.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN i.assignee_name = '' OR i.assignee_name IS NULL THEN 'unassigned' ELSE i.assignee_name END AS "Assignee", COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) AS "AI-linked issues", COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS "PRs", COUNT(DISTINCT sc.session_id) AS "Sessions", COUNT(DISTINCT sc.commit_sha) AS "Commits" FROM _tool_kiro_session_commits sc JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id JOIN pull_request_issues pri ON pri.pull_request_id = pr.id JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = sc.commit_sha WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm."table" = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN ($project)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pri.issue_id) DESC LIMIT 50
